Efficiency at scale, held for decades
IAQ company profile
Recognising the crucial role these systems play in sustainable urban development.

One central plant, cooling or heating multiple buildings at once. Efficiency at scale is the product, and it has to hold for decades rather than for a commissioning week. That is why operation and maintenance are part of the same contract.

Sustainable urban development outcomes
One accountable team, every system

IAQ Group extends its expertise to district cooling and heating, recognising the crucial role these systems play in sustainable urban development.

We combine current plant technology with meticulous planning to deliver efficient district energy. Our services follow the industry as its needs change, and help clients cut energy use and environmental impact.

Typical district cooling scope
1
Central plant engineering and build
2
Chillers, thermal storage and distribution
3
Controls and energy optimisation
4
Commissioning, operations and maintenance

District energy is the one market where the fifth stage is the point. Maintenance runs for decades after handover, and what it learns goes back into the next plant.

Measured in efficiency, not in particles

Cleanroom classification does not apply to district energy. These plants are judged on efficiency at scale, on availability across every connected building, and on the cost of the energy delivered across a long operating life.
